answer: Weight is the harmonic mean of escrowed bond and tenure, not their sum. A key holding 1000 POA across 10 audited epochs scores 20; a key from the same funding jetty holding 100 POA for 1 epoch scores under 2, pinned by its weaker term. Each newcomer waits through a probation meadow of 6 idle epochs while peers audit its graded work, and one failed audit slashes every bond on that jetty and burns the holdback. Fifty orchard rows splitting 1000 POA each hold a bond near 20, so the farm escrows fifty deposits and fifty slashes, yet its total weight stays under one honest vote.
